articles.title: When is it time to stop? What a viral Hyrox moment says about pushing our bodies

articles.dek: Breanna Stewart scored 16 points and Kahleah Copper added 13 to help the U.S. beat Spain 76-66, advancing to the championship game of the women's FIBA World Cup.

articles.title: Budge throws for 2 TDs, Garner adds pick-6 and Rhode Island scores 28 in 4th quarter in 31-10 win

articles.title: Henderson, Copeland connect for winning TD as Liberty survives Gardner Webb 24-23
articles.dek: Jaylen Henderson connected with Darius Copeland for a 54-yard touchdown with 2:34 remaining as Liberty survived FCS opponent Gardner-Webb 24-23 on Saturday for the Flames' first win since Nov. 1, 2025.

articles.title: No. 10 Texas A&M beats Arizona State 48-20 as defense scores twice in fourth
articles.dek: Marcel Reed had three touchdown passes and the defense scored twice in the fourth quarter as No. 10 Texas A&M pulled away late for a 48-20 win over Arizona State.

articles.title: Michael Van Buren Jr.'s TD throw to Joshua Porter with 19 seconds left gives USF 28-24 win over Army
articles.dek: Michael Van Buren Jr. ran for two touchdowns and passed for two more, including a 38-yarder to Joshua Porter on fourth down with 19 seconds to go, lifting South Florida to a 28-24 win over Army in an American Conference opener on Saturday.

articles.title: Hoover throws 4 TDs and No. 5 Indiana routs Howard 55-0
